turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dearest O-lan, do not speak of such things. We will make sure our son is well taken care of and our daughter-in-law will be a good wife to him. You have given us a fine family and your legacy will live on.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know my daughter-in-law will do her best, but Wang Lung, you must look after her and the child as well. Ensure there is enough for all.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please rest assured. Father and I will take care of everything as you wish. I promise to honor your memory and care for our family.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My wife, you worry too much. Your health is our top concern now. Rest easy, knowing our family will thrive.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, I believe you, but please do not neglect our daughter-in-law and grandchildren. Ensure they are not forgotten in the rush of life.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, my dear, you need not worry about a thing. I will see to it that all is well, and our family will carry on with your love and guidance in our hearts.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, I am not trying to trouble you. It is simply my heart's desire to ensure all is set right before I am no longer here to guide you.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, my love, your guidance will always be with us. I will make certain that our family remains strong and united, just as you have always wished.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, I understand your words, but please promise me that you will arrange the marriage for our eldest son as soon as possible. This is what gives me peace.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dearest O-lan, I promise you. We will arrange the marriage as soon as it is right and proper. Your wishes are our command, and your peace is our greatest joy.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, Wang Lung. And eldest son, I hope you will be a good husband and provide for your family.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will do my best to honor your wishes and bring happiness to my wife and our family.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am grateful for your words, eldest son. Now, please ensure that you and your wife will take care of each other and our family after I am gone.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Your wishes are our duty, O-lan. I will see to it that the eldest son and his wife are well cared for and that their marriage is blessed.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I trust you, maid. And Wang Lung, let us not delay any longer. The preparations for the eldest son's marriage must begin at once.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will start preparing for the eldest son's marriage immediately, O-lan. Rest assured, everything will be taken care of.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, maid. Now, Wang Lung, we must ensure that the eldest son's marriage is a joyous occasion despite the circumstances.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not worry, my dearest O-lan. We will make your eldest son's marriage a celebration to remember, filled with joy and happiness. Rest easy, my love.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will begin by preparing the household for the festivities, O-lan. Your wishes will be our guidance.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, I am grateful for your words. Let us focus on making this a time of happiness for our son and his new wife.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]
